title: /mcp/origins/* — configuration field
bodyMarkdown:
## Purpose

One entry in this collection: Request `Origin` allowlist for HTTP mode. It is an origin check, not a CORS implementation: this profile does not emit browser CORS permission headers.

## Constraints and authority

Public schema path: `/mcp/origins/*`. required pattern: "^(?:https://(?:[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?)*|\\[[0-9A-Fa-f:.]+\\])(?::[0-9]{1,5})?(?:/[^?#]*)?|http://(?:localhost|127(?:\\.(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1?[0-9]{1,2})){3}|\\[::1\\])(?::[0-9]{1,5})?(?:/[^?#]*)?)$". Branch-specific requirements and native permission/identity checks still apply; schema input acceptance alone is not authority. Use synthetic declarations in the preview and keep credential bytes outside policy.

## Expected result

The local proposal contains the intended declaration and passes complete-policy validation. Browser Save retains a local draft; it does not activate native configuration, fetch a provider value or grant remote access. Use the corresponding guide for actual native operations.

## Recovery

On denial, verify the exact issuer/client/subject, resource, grant, scopes/roles and active window. Do not widen a grant or reset DPoP replay state as a connection workaround.
